summary: Satellos Bioscience, a Canadian clinical-stage biotech listed on Nasdaq and TSX, furnished a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing an FDA-driven protocol amendment to its BASECAMP Phase 2 pediatric Duchenne muscular dystrophy trial, shifting the primary efficacy endpoint from dynamometry to MRI-measured vastus lateralis fat fraction. No stake, price, or transaction is involved; the board and advisors are not mentioned. Topline 12-week placebo-controlled data are expected Q1 2027. Watch for readout timing, fat-fraction effect size, and any accelerated-approval pathway signals.
